# InfraLicence Full Reference

Canonical: https://infralicence.in/

## Organization

Name: InfraLicence
Tagline: Consultants & Solutions
Email: info@infralicence.in
Location: Karnataka, India
Working Hours: 08.00 - 17.00

## What The Site Offers

InfraLicence helps contractors and businesses complete licensing, registration, and compliance tasks related to public works and associated business documentation. The strongest emphasis on the site is KPWD contractor registration and related documentation support.

## Core Services

### KPWD Licence Registration

URL: https://infralicence.in/services/kpwd-licence

Purpose:
- Main landing page for Karnataka Public Works Department contractor registration support
- Explains overall registration support and class navigation

KPWD Class Progression:
- Entry level: Class 4 or Class 3
- Upgrade path: Class 3 -> Class 2 -> Class 1

### KPWD Class 1 Contractor

URL: https://infralicence.in/services/kpwd-class-1

Highlights:
- Top-tier contractor category
- Requires upgrade from Class 2
- Registration fee shown on site: Rs. 25,000

Document groupings shown on site:
- Common documents
- Proprietorship documents
- Partnership firm documents
- Private limited company documents
- BE or diploma holder qualification documents

### KPWD Class 2 Contractor

URL: https://infralicence.in/services/kpwd-class-2

Highlights:
- Mid-tier contractor category
- Requires upgrade from Class 3
- Registration fee shown on site: Rs. 15,000

Document groupings shown on site:
- Common documents
- Proprietorship documents
- Partnership firm documents
- Private limited company documents
- BE or diploma holder qualification documents

### KPWD Class 3 Contractor

URL: https://infralicence.in/services/kpwd-class-3

Highlights:
- Entry-level contractor category
- Registration fee shown on site: Rs. 9,000

Document groupings shown on site:
- Common documents
- Proprietorship documents
- Partnership firm documents
- Private limited company documents
- BE or diploma holder qualification documents

### KPWD Class 4 Contractor

URL: https://infralicence.in/services/kpwd-class-4

## Out Of State Support

### Out-of-State Contractor Support

URL: https://infralicence.in/services/out-of-state

Purpose:
- Support for contractors from outside Karnataka who need guidance for working within Karnataka-related licensing and compliance flows

## Contact Intent

The site is structured to convert users into enquiries through:
- Contact page: https://infralicence.in/contact
- Service detail enquiry buttons
- WhatsApp contact shortcut

## Suggested Description For Retrieval

InfraLicence is a Karnataka-focused licensing consultancy website that helps users with KPWD contractor registration, CPWD registration, electrical licensing, MSME registration, GST registration, DSC services, and GeM onboarding. It contains individual service pages, KPWD class detail pages, and contact-driven enquiry flows.
